scientific_integrity: All exact constants are supported by an analytic block decomposition, phase-torus optimization and irrational-density argument. Standalone finite checks are corroboration, not proofs of all-time sharpness. Priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact unweighted four-vertex adjacency-walk calculation only; suprema can be nonattained, and no longer-path extension is proved.
title: Sharp complementary quantum-walk contrasts on the four-vertex path
